title: I Come, O Savior, to Thy Table
description: I Come, O Savior, to Thy Table in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 6 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Friedrich Christian Heyder, first published in 1710. The tune, ICH STERBE TÄGLICH, is from Emskirchner Choralbuch, 1756. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: I come, O Sa-vior, to Thy ta_-ble, For weak and wear-y is my soul; Thou, Bread of Life, a-lone art ab_-le To sa-tis-fy and make me whole: Lord, may Thy bo-dy and Thy blood Be for my soul the high-est good!

lines: I come, O Savior, to Thy table,
For weak and weary is my soul;
Thou, Bread of Life, alone art able
To satisfy and make me whole:

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Lord, may Thy body and Thy blood
Be for my soul the highest good!
Oh, grant that I in manner worthy
May now approach Thy heav'nly board
And, as I lowly bow before Thee,
Look only unto Thee, O Lord!
Unworthy though I am, O Savior,
Because I have a sinful heart,
Yet Thou Thy lamb wilt banish never,
For Thou my faithful Shepherd art:
Oh, let me loathe all sin forever
As death and poison to my soul
That I through willful sinning never
May see Thy judgment take its toll!
Thy heart is filled with fervent yearning
That sinners may salvation see
Who, Lord, to Thee in faith are turning;
So I, a sinner, come to Thee.
